name: Sliding Gate Operator SG800
description: Medium-duty sliding gate operator for industrial and commercial entrances.

components.name: Control Board
components.specification: MCU-based control PCB with obstacle detection
components.function: Processes remote/input signals and drives the motor
components.failure: Relay contact wear or water ingress
components.maintenance: Inspect connectors, keep enclosure sealed, verify firmware revision

components.name: Position Sensor
components.function: Detects open/close limits and travel position
components.maintenance: Clean sensor face and verify magnet gap

components.name: Gearbox
components.function: Converts motor speed to gate driving torque
components.maintenance: Inspect oil level and listen for abnormal noise

components.name: Protective Cover
components.maintenance: Tighten fasteners and touch up coating damage
